name: Brumal-Antiphon
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in bioluminescent seas. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The air carries burnt sugar and sulfur, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
For traders, iron and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
